description: Tuned swerve PID gains for the YORv3 base, measured on the floor 2026-08-17. NOT applied by default -- config/base_pid_stock.json is. Opt in with `python robot/yor.py --base-pid-manifest config/base_pid_commissioned.json`. Two reasons it is opt-in. (1) This drive loop is feed-forward dominated and tracks its setpoint (commissioning evidence: steady error 0.000 native median at 0.25 native), so DRIVE_VEL_SCALE = 2.0 -- which exists to compensate for the stock P-only loop's ~2x undershoot -- becomes a stale doubling, and the base runs at about twice every commanded speed while BaseOdometry records half of reality. (2) Every floor run behind these numbers clamped controller output to +/-0.25 while this manifest ships the drive range at +/-1.0, so P is effectively 7x and D 5x what they were measured under; re-measure before relying on them above 0.25 output. RAM is not persistent: re-run the preflight after every SPARK power cycle. See docs/BASE_COMMAND_LOOP_REVIEW.md finding 6.
drive_command_scale_notes: Derived from a floor measurement on 2026-08-24, not from arithmetic alone. That run (stock gains, scale 2.0, 0.15 m/s for 5 s) drove 0.59 m by tape while the wheels reported 12.466 motor rotations. Back-solving the metres-per-motor-rotation gives 0.0473, which matches PHASE0_BASELINE's five-tape-run calibration of 0.047530598 to 0.4% and rules out swerve_odom.py's 0.049922 (5.5% high). The controllers are configured from 0.050780 (velocity_cf x 60), so a loop that tracks its setpoint perfectly needs 0.050780 / 0.047531 = 1.0684 to make a commanded m/s a true m/s. STILL PROVISIONAL in one respect: it assumes the commissioned loop tracks exactly. Re-run tools/measure_drive_scale.py --manifest config/base_pid_commissioned.json and use the number it reports.

drive.notes: Feed-forward dominated rather than a conventional PD loop. Kd is deliberately zero: a tested value of 10 caused an audibly harsh 100 Hz torque ripple and rough deceleration during floor testing.

steering.notes: The +/-0.25 output limit is part of the commissioned set. Full-range steering (Kp=10, Kd=0, output -1.0..1.0) is NOT validated and must stay a separate commissioning experiment.
